review_type: Postqualification read-only explanatory review of the first retained result; no output-informed changes or additional model executions.
reviewer_relationship: Implementation contributor reviewing newly authorized qualification outputs; this is not independent human linguistic adjudication.

authored_panel_scope.authorship: Independently authored by the coordinating assistant before native or planner outputs; no external corpus or human gold claim. Implementing agent is not given this panel.
authored_panel_scope.definition: 86 pre-frozen assistant-authored cases, with 30 intended agreement errors, 42 valid controls, 10 policy/structure guards and 4 unsupported locales.
limitations: This demonstrates a finite incremental exact-correction gain on this selected authored panel. It does not estimate general German precision, recall, prevalence, or production safety.
The 24 error/valid pairs intentionally share wording and structure; neither these pairs nor corrected rechecks are additional independent linguistic samples.
The 22 corrected rechecks repeat selected qualification content and do not increase the 86-case or 30-error denominators.
A guard is not a claim that its text is grammatical. A successful empty planner result may be explicit abstention.
Unsupported locale cases remain separate from correction coverage and valid-text controls.
The report marks editor_gate_included false; this linguistic outcome does not replace separately recorded editor safety gates.

qualification_outcome.interpretation: The 17 added exact corrections consist of 11 subject-prepositional-modifier errors and 6 initial-adverb inversion errors. Five baseline exact corrections remain exact with duplicate native findings suppressed; no error case was changed incorrectly.

baseline_detection_and_choice_handling.policy: The frozen evaluator applies only findings containing exactly one replacement, and exact correction additionally requires all choices resolved. A finding with multiple choices remains visible but cannot earn an exact correction through gold-assisted choice.
baseline_detection_and_choice_handling.observed_scope: The updated deterministic provider supports complete phrase alternatives, but no multiple-choice finding occurred in this qualification. Its five detected error cases were all singleton exact corrections. No multi-choice cases are relabeled as undetected or automatically solved.

valid_guard_and_unsupported_behavior.interpretation: All 42 valid controls remain unchanged; the planner explicitly preserves 16 compatible cases and abstains on 26. Ten guards have no native finding, including two ignored-rule suppressions. Four locale cases report unsupported.

recheck_interpretation.meaning: Clean means zero further native findings: 18 corrected outputs are explicitly compatible and 4 are conservatively outside the analyzed subset. It does not mean all corrected annotations were affirmed grammatical.

missed_error_review.interpretation: All eight missed errors remain unchanged in all three arms. Four encounter frozen vocabulary/shape limits, three encounter conflicting or unsupported native annotations, and one fails the lexical spelling gate. These are recorded limits, not requests to tune this consumed qualification panel.

miss_review.explanation: The predicate word offen is absent from the shared reviewed predicate vocabulary. The planner retains im Flur as the subject modifier and places the unconsumed offen tail into another residual span; its two-span guard then abstains.
miss_review.diagnostic_caveat: The recorded reason multiple-prepositional-phrases is an internal shape-limit label. This authored sentence contains one actual PP, not two; the second residual span is offen.

miss_review.explanation: Native dependencies attach Baby as sb to the finite root, but its Case feature is Acc. The planner requires a nominative common-noun subject and refuses this internally conflicting annotation.
Draußen is outside the frozen initial-adverb allowlist. Its root-attached ADV/mo analysis does not override that vocabulary boundary.

Shared lexical evidence licenses plural for die Schlüssel, whereas the native subject annotation predicts singular feminine. The planner requires model and lexical number to agree before changing the verb.
Drinnen is outside the frozen initial-adverb allowlist. The sentence has a nominative plural subject and a root-attached initial adverb, but those facts do not expand the configured vocabulary.

The recorded noun evidence is unknown-noun for Züge. In the shared-facts implementation this reason is produced when the prepared noun fails morphology.acceptsSpelling; a plausible native lemma/number prediction cannot bypass that lexical gate.
miss_review.diagnostic_caveat: This result identifies the specific lexical spelling-acceptance gate. It does not establish that every noun lookup representation lacks Züge, and no new lookup or model execution was performed for this review.

miss_review.explanation: Native analysis assigns Kinder accusative object dependency oa, leaving no sb subject. The planner abstains before reaching later vocabulary/word-order checks.
miss_review.diagnostic_caveat: Gern is also outside the frozen initial-adverb allowlist, but the observed first rejection is not-one-subject; this case is not attributed to an unexecuted later check.

miss_review.explanation: Offen is outside the shared reviewed predicate vocabulary. The remaining one-word tail cannot form the one complete optional PP, producing unsupported-phrase-tail. The baseline also leaves this input unchanged.
